answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The karst is the serial tenure, the comet the custody window that must elapse, and the canyon the standing released at the end of it; the karst is personal, the comet is not skippable, and the canyon cannot be inherited by a sibling.
